children: Solana client developer Anza said SIMD-0525 has been completed and 200 millisecond slots are now live on the Solana mainnet beta. According to ChainCatcher, Anza said block finalization frequency has doubled from genesis, while the length of one epoch has been reduced from about two days to about one day.
Anza was formed by the former core engineering team at Solana Labs and is responsible for maintaining Solana validator client Agave.

title: Anza Says Solana Mainnet Beta Has Launched 200 Millisecond Slot Intervals
